# SRD 5.2.1 coverage (generated, do not edit by hand)

This page lists every record in the SRD 5.2.1 content and says what the app does with it. Each record is in
one of three states:

- **Enforced:** the server applies it in play. The GM may still supply a fact the map can't see, such as a
  creature's line of sight or its degree of cover, and a note names any narrative part left to the table.
- **Guided:** the app tracks it or applies part of it, and a person applies the rest. It may count a use, open a
  prompt, roll a check or post a reminder. The note says which part is the table's.
- **Reference:** the app shows the text and applies nothing.

A note names the module that applies a record, so it can be checked in the code. Enforcement follows the
table's rules policy: under advise the server warns where it would refuse, and under off it says nothing.

Regenerate this page with `npm run map`. A test (`apps/server/test/srd-coverage.test.ts`) fails when the page
is stale, when a curated row is missing or names a record that no longer exists, and when a sampled claim
stops matching the engine. Known gaps in enforced records are GitHub issues.

## How records are classified

Most records are classified from the mechanics their content bundle carries, because the engine is data-driven
(`apps/server/src/srd-coverage.ts`); the rest are curated (`apps/server/src/srd-coverage-curated.ts`).

- **Spells:** a cast resolves in `action-resolution.ts` and the steps in `resolution/`, at the caster's own
  numbers. A spell is enforced when its cast applies its attack, save, damage, healing or lasting effect, ends
  spells or curses (`resolution/dispel.ts`), or when the area it leaves applies them as creatures enter it or
  start or end a turn there (`spell-zones.ts`), or when it raises, cuts or breaks the map's walls or works its
  doors (`spell-walls.ts`).
  Guided when the app spends the slot and holds the Concentration, the area or a save while a person applies
  what the spell does. A spell whose cast leaves a rider to the table (Storm of Vengeance's later turns) is
  curated as guided, with a note.
- **Monster actions:** enforced when the attack, damage, healing or effect resolves, a save's failure leaves
  something, or the server offers the action as the generic action it names (Nimble Escape's Disengage or Hide).
  An action that casts one spell takes that spell's state; a list takes the least of the spells it casts whose
  outcome isn't the story's (what Detect Magic senses), each a cast action at the stat block's numbers. Guided when
  the server resolves it and reminds the GM of the rest (a hit's rider the build doesn't read), rolls a save whose
  failure is the GM's, or only counts a use, a legendary cost or a recharge.
- **Class features, species traits and feats:** enforced when their riders (an action that resolves, an
  effect, a modifier the engine reads, a grant) or the builder's picks apply them. Guided when the app counts
  their uses or offers an action that only spends a use, or when part of what they do is left to a person.
- **Magic items and gear:** enforced for weapons, armor, ammunition, Spell Scrolls and items whose riders
  apply. An item that casts spells takes the state of the spells it casts. Guided when the app only tracks
  Attunement, charges or a curse, or binds the item to a base weapon or armor without its magic. Tools are
  guided too: the server rolls their checks, and the GM sets what they achieve.
- **Backgrounds, weapons and armor:** enforced. The builder applies a background, and every weapon and armor
  statistic reaches the rolls.
- **Monster traits, conditions and the rules glossary:** curated by hand, each with a note.

Records the data can't classify, because the engine handles them in code or their data applies only part of
what they do, are curated too (`RECORD_OVERRIDES`). Each group lists their notes after its records.

| Find Familiar | enforced | The familiar takes one of the spell's forms or another Challenge Rating 0 Beast, as a Celestial, Fey or Fiend, within 10 feet (summons.ts). It rolls its own Initiative and can't attack. A Bonus Action lets the caster's player see through its eyes until the start of the caster's next turn (vision/audience.ts), and a Magic action dismisses it or sends it to its pocket dimension and calls it back (summon-orders.ts). A touch spell is delivered from its space with its Reaction within 100 feet (summons.ts). Casting it again changes its form. Its telepathy is the GM's. |
| Find Steed | enforced | The Otherworldly Steed at the slot's level, a Celestial, Fey or Fiend, appears within 30 feet and acts right after the caster (summons.ts); it can be ridden (mounts.ts). It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the caster dies, and a new casting replaces it. |
| Finger of Death | enforced | The save and its Necrotic damage are applied. A Humanoid it kills rises as a Zombie at the start of the caster's next turn (risen.ts), under the caster's command and on its side, in the corpse's space and acting right after the caster (summons.ts): a player's caster runs it. |
| Fire Shield | enforced | The shield picked gives Resistance to Cold (warm) or Fire (chill), and a creature within 5 feet that hits the caster with a melee attack roll takes 2d8 Fire or Cold (resolution/struck.ts). Its light is carried with the caster's token (vision/cast-sight.ts). |
| Fire Storm | enforced | The cast places up to ten 10-foot Cubes, each touching another and within 150 feet of the caster (multi-templates.ts), and each creature under any of them makes the Dexterity save once against 7d10 Fire damage, half on a success. Setting flammable objects alight is the GM's. |
| Flaming Sphere | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save against 2d6 Fire damage when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere. The Bonus Action moves the sphere up to 30 feet (zone-moves.ts), and a creature it rams makes the save. It sheds its light for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). |
| Flesh to Stone | enforced | A failed save imposes Restrained, and the repeat saves are counted: three successes end it, three failures Petrify it (save-stages.ts). A success leaves Speed 0 until the start of the caster's next turn, and a Construct succeeds without a roll. |
| Floating Disk | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The disk, what it carries and how it follows the caster are the GM's: weight isn't tracked. |
| Fog Cloud | enforced | The Sphere is Heavily Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts), and its radius grows 20 feet for each slot level above 1 (spell-zone-state.ts). Gust of Wind disperses it. |
| Forbiddance | enforced | The warded area, up to a 200-foot square, lasts a day on the game clock (spell-zones.ts, game-time.ts). An Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend or Undead that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage, chosen at the cast. Strict rules refuse a teleport into it (zone-barriers.ts). The password that spares a creature is the GM's. |
| Forcecage | enforced | The cast raises the 20-foot cage on its placed Cube as bars that stop movement and leave sight, attacks and spells through (spell-walls.ts), and moves a creature standing in the bars out of them. A creature that teleports out first makes a Charisma save against the caster's spell save DC, which the server rolls, and a failure keeps it in and wastes the teleport (forcecage.ts). Disintegrate destroys the cage, and it goes when the spell ends. The solid 10-foot box and its reach into the Ethereal Plane are the GM's. |
| Freedom of Movement | guided | speed.ts gives the target a Swim Speed equal to its Speed, terrain.ts charges it nothing extra for Difficult Terrain, and the target can't have the Paralyzed or Restrained condition (effects.ts), whatever its source. Keeping its Speed from being reduced and slipping free of restraints are the GM's. |
| Gaseous Form | enforced | The willing target becomes a misty cloud: its only speed is a Fly Speed of 10 feet that hovers, it can share a creature's space, has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, Immunity to Prone and Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, and it can't attack, speak or cast spells. A Magic action or 0 Hit Points ends it. Narrow openings and liquids are the GM's. |
| Gentle Repose | enforced | resolution/revival.ts takes only a corpse, and the game time it spends under the spell's 10 days doesn't count against a revival's limit (death.ts). Keeping it from becoming Undead is the GM's. |
| Giant Insect | enforced | A Giant Insect at the slot's level in the form picked appears within 60 feet and acts right after the caster with its spell attack modifier and save DC (summons.ts); uncommanded, it takes the Dodge action (summon-turns.ts). It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the Concentration ends. |
| Glibness | enforced | A Charisma check's d20 counts as at least 15 for the hour (ability-checks.ts). How magic reads the caster's truthfulness is the GM's. |
| Globe of Invulnerability | enforced | The 10-foot Emanation stays where its caster stood (spell-zones.ts). zone-barriers.ts keeps a spell of level 5 or lower cast from outside from affecting the creatures within, one level higher for each slot level above 6. |
| Glyph of Warding | guided | The explosive rune lasts until it goes off, in a fight or out of one, drawn for the GM and the caster's player alone. The first creature that steps onto it sets it off: each creature in the 20-foot Sphere makes the Dexterity save against 5d8 damage of the type chosen at the cast, and the spell ends (spell-zones.ts). Other triggers, noticing the glyph and the spell glyph are the GM's. |
| Goodberry | enforced | resolution/provisions.ts puts ten berries in the caster's inventory, gone when the spell's 24 hours end (effects.ts). Eating one (actor.nourish) restores 1 Hit Point, takes the eater's Bonus Action on its turn in a fight, and counts as a day's food while the GM tracks food and water (survival.ts). |
| Grease | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save when a creature enters the square or ends its turn there, and a failure leaves it Prone. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). zone-ground.ts makes the square Difficult Terrain. |
| Guidance | enforced | The touched creature adds 1d4 to its checks with the skill picked at the cast while the caster concentrates (ability-checks.ts). |
| Gust of Wind | enforced | The cast's save pushes a creature that fails 15 feet away from the caster, and the Line disperses the fog and clouds it overlaps (vision/cast-sight.ts). spell-zones.ts repeats the save for a creature ending its turn in the Line, zone-ground.ts charges 2 feet for every foot a creature in it moves closer to the caster, and the Bonus Action points the Line another way from the caster (zone-moves.ts). Putting out flames is the table's. |
| Heal | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores 70 Hit Points, 10 more for each slot level above 6, and ends Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned, for one creature (resolution/spell-targets.ts). |
| Heroes' Feast | enforced | Up to twelve creatures gain Resistance to Poison damage, Immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, and 2d10 rolled for each to its Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points for 24 hours of game time (resolution/grant.ts). The hour the feast takes is the GM's to time. |
| Hideous Laughter | enforced | A failed save imposes Prone and Incapacitated, repeated at the end of each of the target's turns and each time it takes damage, with Advantage then (save-stages.ts). It can't stand up while it laughs (actor-conditions.ts). |
| Hold Person | enforced | A failed save imposes Paralyzed, repeated at the end of each of the target's turns. resolution/spell-targets.ts takes one Humanoid, one more for each slot level above 2. |
| Holy Aura | enforced | While the caster and its allies stand in the 30-foot Emanation, zone-auras.ts gives them Advantage on saving throws and Disadvantage to attack rolls against them. A Fiend or an Undead that hits one with a melee attack makes the Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn (resolution/struck.ts). |
| Ice Storm | enforced | The cast's Dexterity save deals the Bludgeoning and Cold damage, half on a success. zone-ground.ts makes the Cylinder Difficult Terrain of ice until the end of the caster's next turn. |
| Imprisonment | guided | A failed save takes the target off the map until the GM ends the spell (off-plane.ts). The form of the prison, the 24 hours of immunity on a success and the ending trigger are the GM's. |
| Incendiary Cloud | guided | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save against 10d8 Fire damage on the cast and when a creature enters the cloud or ends its turn there, once a turn. At the start of each of the caster's turns it moves the cloud 10 feet straight away from the caster, and a creature the cloud moves onto makes the save. The cloud is Heavily Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Choosing another direction is the GM's, who drags the area. |
| Insect Plague | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Constitution save against 4d10 Piercing damage on the cast and when a creature enters the Sphere or ends its turn there, once a turn. zone-ground.ts makes the Sphere Difficult Terrain, and it is Lightly Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). |
| Irresistible Dance | enforced | A failed save Charms the target, holds its Speed at 0, gives it Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls and attackers Advantage against it, and offers it an action to collect itself with a Wisdom save at the spell save DC (builtin-actions.ts). A success holds its Speed at 0 until the end of its next turn. |
| Jump | enforced | Each target can leap up to 30 feet for 10 feet of movement once on each of its turns for 1 minute (jumping.ts). |
| Knock | enforced | Aimed at a door on the map that the caster sees within 60 feet, it takes away one of what holds it shut, a lock, a stuck or barred state or a spike, and holds an Arcane Lock off for 10 minutes (doors.ts). A door Stone Shape sealed stays shut. The knock heard 300 feet away is the table's. |
| Levitate | guided | A failed save lifts the target 20 feet (falling.ts); while levitating it moves only as if climbing (altitude.ts), and it floats gently down when the spell ends. A willing target's save, and moving it up or down on the caster's turn, are the GM's, who sets its height. |
| Light | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The light and the object it shines from are the GM's. |
| Mage Hand | enforced | The hand appears as a token at a point within 30 feet (summons.ts); a Magic action moves it up to 30 feet (summon-orders.ts), and it vanishes more than 30 feet from the caster or when the spell is cast again. Aimed at a door on the map within 30 feet, it opens or shuts an unlocked one (resolution/cast-walls.ts), and a door held shut stays shut. What else it handles is the GM's. |
| Magic Circle | guided | zone-barriers.ts keeps Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead from walking into the Cylinder, and strict rules refuse their move across its edge. Their Disadvantage on attacks into it, their teleport save and the inverted circle are the GM's. |
| Magic Jar | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The container, the possession of a host and the return to the body are the GM's: control of one creature passing to another is not modeled. |
| Magic Weapon | enforced | The caster's nonmagical weapon picked gains +1 to its attack and damage rolls, +2 from a level 3 slot and +3 from level 6 (equipment-derivation.ts), for the hour; casting it again moves it. A weapon another creature carries is the GM's. |
| Major Image | guided | resolution/concentration.ts holds the caster's Concentration on it, and from a level 4 slot it lasts until dispelled with none. The illusion itself is the GM's to run. |
| Mass Cure Wounds | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores 5d8 plus the modifier to up to six creatures the caster picks, and resolution/spell-targets.ts keeps them within one 30-foot Sphere centered within 60 feet. |
| Mass Heal | enforced | resolution/heal.ts divides the 700 Hit Points evenly among the creatures the caster picks, none past its maximum, and ends Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned on each. A different split is the caster's to make by hand. |
| Mass Suggestion | enforced | A failed save imposes Charmed on up to twelve creatures (resolution/spell-targets.ts). What the suggestion makes them do is the GM's. |
| Maze | enforced | The target leaves the map while the caster concentrates (off-plane.ts) and returns to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied one. It may take an action for a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check, which ends the spell on a success (resolution/builtins.ts). |
| Mending | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The repair is the GM's. |
| Message | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The whisper and its reply are the table's. |
| Meteor Swarm | enforced | The cast places up to four 40-foot-radius Spheres at different points within range (multi-templates.ts), and a creature in more than one makes the Dexterity save once, against 20d6 Fire and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage, half on a success. Setting objects alight is the GM's. |
| Mind Blank | enforced | The target is immune to Psychic damage (hit-points.ts) and the Charmed condition (effects.ts). What it hides from divination is the GM's. |
| Mind Spike | enforced | The save and its Psychic damage are applied, and a failure outlines the target to the caster: Invisible gives it nothing against the caster's attacks or the caster's against it (resolution/attack.ts). Knowing where it is, and hiding, are the GM's. |
| Mirror Image | enforced | The caster has three duplicates for a minute. Each hit on it rolls a d6 a duplicate, and on a 3 or higher the hit lands on a duplicate, which is destroyed, ending the spell with the last; an attacker Blinded or with Blindsight or Truesight is unaffected (resolution/mirror-image.ts). |
| Mislead | enforced | The caster turns Invisible until it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell, while the spell goes on (resolution/attack.ts), and its illusory double appears in its space (summons.ts): invulnerable and in no one's way, seeing for the caster's player (vision/audience.ts), moved twice the caster's Speed with a Magic action (summon-orders.ts). How the double behaves is the player's to describe. |
| Misty Step | enforced | granted-moves.ts gives the caster a 30-foot teleport for the turn, which movement-rules.ts takes at once to an unoccupied space it can see and refuses beyond its range. |
| Moonbeam | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Constitution save against 2d10 Radiant damage on the cast and when a creature enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, once a turn. On the caster's later turns a Magic action moves the Cylinder up to 60 feet (zone-moves.ts), and a creature it moves onto makes the save. Its Dim Light is placed for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). A shape-shifted creature that fails returns to its true form and can't shape-shift while the spell lasts (transform/rules.ts); the GM ends that sooner when it leaves the Cylinder. |
| Pass without Trace | enforced | zone-auras.ts gives the caster and its allies +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks while they stand in the 30-foot Emanation. Leaving no tracks is the GM's to narrate. |
| Passwall | guided | Aimed at a wall on the map within 30 feet that the caster sees, it cuts a 5-foot passage that sight and movement pass through for the hour (spell-walls.ts). Moving the creatures still in the passage when it closes is the GM's. |
| Phantasmal Force | guided | A failed save leaves the illusion on the target for the spell's duration, and End an Effect lets it study the illusion with an Intelligence (Investigation) check to end it (ending-actions.ts). The illusion, and the 2d8 Psychic damage it deals on the caster's turns, are the GM's. |
| Phantasmal Killer | enforced | The save and its 4d10 Psychic damage are applied, and a failure leaves Disadvantage on the target's ability checks and attack rolls, with the save repeated at the end of each of its turns until it succeeds and the 4d10 again on each failed repeat (save-stages.ts). |
| Phantom Steed | enforced | A Riding Horse with a Speed of 100 feet appears within 30 feet for the hour (summons.ts) and can be ridden (mounts.ts); any damage ends it. |
| Planar Binding | enforced | Only a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey or a Fiend can be the target. A failed Charisma save binds it to serve the caster for the spell's duration (resolution/concentration.ts), under the caster's command and on its side (summons.ts). What it is told to do, and lengthening another spell's summoning, are the GM's. |
| Plant Growth | guided | Overgrowth makes a creature spend 4 feet of movement for every foot it moves in the Sphere (zone-ground.ts), until the GM ends the area. Leaving parts of the Sphere out, and the 8-hour Enrichment, are the GM's. |
| Polymorph | enforced | A failed Wisdom save turns the target into a Beast of its Challenge Rating or lower that the caster picks (transform/options.ts): the Beast's statistics with the target's own Hit Points and creature type, Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast's Hit Points, no speech or spells, and gear melded. It ends with Concentration, when those Temporary Hit Points run out, or at death (transform/rules.ts). |
| Power Word Heal | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores all the target's Hit Points and ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned, for one creature (resolution/spell-targets.ts). Standing up from Prone with its Reaction is the creature's choice. |
| Power Word Kill | enforced | resolution/kill.ts kills a target with 100 Hit Points or fewer outright, a character with no death saves, and deals 12d12 Psychic damage to any other. Death Ward turns the death aside. |
| Power Word Stun | enforced | A target with 150 Hit Points or fewer is Stunned and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns; a tougher one's Speed is 0 until the start of the caster's next turn (resolution/pending.ts). |
| Prayer of Healing | enforced | The 2d8 Hit Points are applied, each target gains a Short Rest's benefits, and a creature it healed is refused until it finishes a Long Rest (resolution/prayer-of-healing.ts). |
| Prestidigitation | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. Its minor tricks are the GM's. |
| Prismatic Spray | guided | resolution/prismatic.ts rolls the d8 for each creature in the Cone, two rays on an 8, and the 12d6 once. Red to Blue ask the Dexterity save against their damage, half on a success. Indigo Restrains on a failure, with the Constitution saves counted until three successes end it or three failures Petrify it (save-stages.ts). Violet Blinds on a failure until the start of the caster's next turn; its Wisdom save then, and the trip to another plane, are the GM's. |
| Prismatic Wall | guided | The save against Blinded for a creature near the wall is applied, and the wall on its placed Line blocks sight and sheds its Bright and Dim Light for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Each layer's save and effect, and breaking the layers, are the GM's. |
| Project Image | enforced | The illusory copy appears anywhere on the map (summons.ts), seeing for the caster's player (vision/audience.ts) and moved 60 feet with a Magic action (summon-orders.ts). Any damage to it ends it and the spell. Its intangibility to touch and a Study action to discern it are the GM's. |
| Protection from Evil and Good | enforced | Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target and can't make it Charmed or Frightened (effects.ts). Possession, and Advantage on a new save against such a creature's effect, are the GM's. |
| Protection from Poison | enforced | The cast ends Poisoned and leaves Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned, for an hour counted on the game clock (game-time.ts). |
| Raise Dead | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than 10 days of game time, less any time under Gentle Repose, one Undead when it died, and one whose body or head is gone. It returns with 1 Hit Point and no longer Poisoned, and takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that eases by 1 with each Long Rest (death.ts). |
| Ray of Enfeeblement | enforced | A failed Constitution save gives Disadvantage on Strength attack rolls, checks and saves and takes 1d8 off each damage roll, never below 1, repeating the save at the end of each turn; a success gives Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the caster's next turn (resolution/pending.ts). |
| Regenerate | enforced | The 4d8 + 15 Hit Points are applied to one creature, which regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns for the hour (turn-boundaries.ts). Regrowing severed parts is the GM's. |
| Reincarnate | guided | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than 10 days and returns it with all its Hit Points in a new body, rolling the d10 for its species (a 1 rolls again) and noting it on the creature. Rebuilding the sheet with the new species, and the soul's consent, are the GM's. |
| Remove Curse | enforced | resolution/dispel.ts ends every effect marked a curse on the target (Hex, Bestow Curse, Geas), and breaks its Attunement to a cursed item so the item can be removed; the item's own curse stays. A curse the app doesn't track is the GM's. |
| Resilient Sphere | enforced | A failed Dexterity save shuts the target in the sphere while the caster concentrates (enclosures.ts). An attack or spell on it from outside, or from it on anything outside, meets Total Cover's refusal, and an area leaves it out. Disintegrate aimed at it destroys the sphere, harms nothing inside and ends the spell. Rolling the sphere along, and a willing target, are the GM's. |
| Resistance | enforced | The touched creature takes 1d4 off damage of the type picked, once a turn, while the caster concentrates (hit-points.ts). |
| Resurrection | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than a century, one Undead when it died, and one whose body is gone; a lost head is restored. It returns with all its Hit Points, no longer Poisoned, with a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that eases by 1 with each Long Rest (death.ts). For a creature dead 365 days or longer the caster can't cast spells and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until a Long Rest. Death by old age is the GM's to rule. |
| Revivify | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target that isn't dead, died more than a minute of game time ago (death.ts keeps the time of death: a fight's rounds, then the game clock), or lost its body or its head. The cast returns it with 1 Hit Point and spends the diamond (resolution/components.ts). Death by old age is the GM's to rule. |
| Sanctuary | enforced | resolution/ward.ts asks the Wisdom save of a creature that targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell; a failure spends nothing and turns it away from the warded creature for the rest of its turn, so it picks another target. Areas aren't stopped, and the spell ends when the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell or deals damage (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Sequester | enforced | The target is Invisible and Unconscious until the spell ends, which taking damage does (effects.ts). The end condition the caster sets, and hiding from divination, are the GM's. |
| Shapechange | enforced | The caster takes a form of its level or Challenge Rating or lower, not a Construct or an Undead, keeping its mind, proficiencies and Spellcasting, with Temporary Hit Points from the first form. A Magic action takes a new form while the spell lasts, and the caster picks whether its gear is worn or melds. |
| Shillelagh | enforced | The cast binds to the Club or Quarterstaff the caster picks (resolution/grant-extras.ts): its attack and damage rolls use the better of Strength and the spellcasting ability, its die becomes a d8 (d10 at level 5, d12 at 11, 2d6 at 17), and a hit deals Force or its own type (item-actions.ts). Casting it again moves it, and it ends once the weapon leaves the pack (bound-weapons.ts). |
| Silence | enforced | zone-auras.ts makes a creature Deafened and Immune to Thunder damage while it stands in the Sphere, and silence.ts refuses a spell with a Verbal component cast from inside it (resolution/components.ts). |
| Sleep | enforced | A failed save imposes Incapacitated until the end of the target's next turn, then the second save leaves it Unconscious on a failure (save-stages.ts). Damage ends either stage, and so does a creature within 5 feet taking the Shake Awake action (resolution/builtins.ts). An elf or a creature immune to Exhaustion succeeds without a roll. |
| Sleet Storm | guided | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save when a creature enters the Cylinder or starts its turn there, and a failure leaves it Prone and ends its Concentration. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). zone-ground.ts makes the Cylinder Difficult Terrain of ice, and it is Heavily Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Dousing the flames in it is the GM's. |
| Sorcerous Burst | guided | The attack and the chosen damage type are applied. Rolling another d8 on each 8 is the GM's. |
| Spare the Dying | enforced | The cast makes a creature at 0 Hit Points Stable with no check (resolution/stabilize.ts), within 15 feet, 30 at level 5, 60 at level 11 and 120 at level 17 (resolution/spell-targets.ts). |
| Spike Growth | enforced | spell-zones.ts deals 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet a creature travels into or within the Sphere, and zone-ground.ts makes the Sphere Difficult Terrain. Whether a creature saw the danger before it moved in is the GM's. |
| Spirit Guardians | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the save when a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, and charges an affected creature double for each step it moves inside (terrain.ts). The creatures the caster designates are its allies. |
| Spiritual Weapon | enforced | The force appears within 60 feet (summons.ts) and the cast's attack reaches a creature within 5 feet of it; each later Bonus Action moves it up to 20 feet first and strikes from there (summon-strikes.ts). The force can't be harmed and fills no space. |
| Stone Shape | guided | Aimed at a door on the map the caster touches, it seals the door shut so that no check opens it; aimed at a wall, it cuts a lasting 5-foot passage through it (spell-walls.ts, doors.ts). The other shapes it makes are the GM's. |
| Storm of Vengeance | guided | The first turn's save, Thunder damage and Deafened condition are applied. The storm's turns 2 to 10 are the GM's. |
| Summon Dragon | enforced | The Draconic Spirit at the slot's level appears within 60 feet and acts right after the caster with its spell attack modifier and save DC, its Rends half the slot's level (summons.ts); uncommanded, it takes the Dodge action (summon-turns.ts). The caster shares the Resistance picked while it lasts. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the Concentration ends. |
| Thaumaturgy | enforced | The cast keeps the wonder picked for a minute (resolution/grant-extras.ts), and Booming Voice gives Advantage on Intimidation checks (ability-checks.ts). Aimed at a door on the map within 30 feet, Invisible Hand flings an unlocked door open or slams it shut (resolution/cast-walls.ts). What the other wonders look and sound like is the GM's. |
| Time Stop | guided | time-stop.ts rolls 1d4 + 1 and gives the caster that many turns in a row; an action of its that targets another creature, or a move more than 1,000 feet from where it cast the spell, ends it. An effect it created that later reaches another creature is the GM's to end it on. |
| Tiny Hut | guided | The dome stays where it was cast (zone-barriers.ts): only the creatures inside it at the cast pass through it, and a spell of level 3 or lower cast from outside can't reach inside. Its light, its one-way sight and its end when the caster leaves are the GM's. |
| True Polymorph | guided | Creature into Creature is applied: an unwilling target saves, a willing one doesn't, and it takes a stat block of its Challenge Rating or lower with Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points, no speech or spells. Object into Creature, Creature into Object and the transformation made permanent after an hour of Concentration are the GM's. |
| True Resurrection | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than 200 years, and brings back one whose body is gone (Disintegrate) in a new body. It returns with all its Hit Points, its poison, curses and Contagion ended. Where a new body appears, and the stat block of an Undead returned to life, are the GM's. |
| True Strike | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The weapon attack with the spellcasting ability, and its Radiant damage, are the GM's. |
| Tsunami | guided | The wall's first save and damage are applied. Its movement and the damage on later turns are the GM's. |
| Unseen Servant | enforced | The Invisible servant appears within 60 feet with AC 10, 1 Hit Point and Strength 2 and can't attack (summons.ts). A Bonus Action sends it 15 feet (summon-orders.ts), and it ends more than 60 feet from the caster. Its tasks are the GM's. |
| Wall of Fire | enforced | spell-zones.ts deals 5d8 Fire damage to a creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in it, after the cast's Dexterity save, and the wall blocks sight for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). The burning side's damage within 10 feet and the ring form are the GM's. |
| Wall of Force | enforced | The cast raises the wall on its placed Line as walls that stop movement and leave sight through (spell-walls.ts). A creature in its space is moved out of it, the caster's allies to the caster's side and the rest to the far side. Nothing damages it, Disintegrate destroys it whole and ends the spell, and it goes when the Concentration ends. Its hemisphere and globe forms are the GM's to draw. |
| Wall of Ice | enforced | The save and its Cold damage for creatures in the wall's space are applied, and they are moved out of it. The wall rises on its placed Line as 10-foot sections that stop movement and leave sight through (spell-walls.ts), each an object with AC 12 and 30 Hit Points, Immunity to Cold damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage that is gone at 0 Hit Points (objects.ts). It goes when the Concentration ends. The frigid air a broken section leaves, and the dome and sphere forms, are the GM's. |
| Wall of Stone | enforced | The cast raises the wall on its placed Line as 10-foot stone panels that stop movement and sight, each an object with AC 15 and 180 Hit Points that is gone at 0 Hit Points (spell-walls.ts, objects.ts). A creature in its space is moved out of it. The wall stays for good once the caster holds Concentration for the full 10 minutes, and goes if the Concentration ends sooner. Its other shapes, and the save of a creature it would shut in, are the GM's. |
| Wall of Thorns | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save against 7d8 Slashing damage when a creature enters the wall or ends its turn there, once a turn, after the cast's 7d8 Piercing. zone-ground.ts makes a creature spend 4 feet of movement for every foot it moves through the wall, and the wall blocks sight for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Its circle form is the GM's. |
| Warding Bond | guided | The target has +1 to AC and saving throws and Resistance to all damage for the hour. The caster's share of its damage, and the spell ending at 60 feet apart, are the GM's. |
| Water Breathing | enforced | The cast gives each target the water-breathing effect for 24 hours, which ends any breath it holds and spares it from holding one (breath.ts). |
| Web | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save the first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, and a failure leaves it Restrained, escaped with a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell save DC. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). zone-ground.ts makes the webs Difficult Terrain, and they are Lightly Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Burning the webs away is the GM's, who ends the area. |
| Weird | enforced | The save, its Psychic damage and Frightened are applied, with the repeat save at the end of each turn and 5d10 Psychic damage on each failed repeat (save-stages.ts). |
| Wind Walk | guided | Each willing target becomes a cloud with a Fly Speed of 300 feet that hovers, Immunity to Prone and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage; it can only Dash or take the Magic action that ends the form, which leaves it Stunned for 1 minute. Turning back into a cloud while the spell lasts, and the descent when it ends, are the GM's. |
| Wind Wall | enforced | The save and its Bludgeoning damage are applied. While the caster concentrates, zone-walls.ts makes an arrow, a bolt or a thrown weapon miss a target across the wall, and zone-barriers.ts bars a Small or smaller creature in the air from crossing it. A giant's Rock and spells go through. Its hold on gases is the GM's. |

## Barbarian features

**Enforced (22):** Ability Score Improvement · Barbarian Subclass · Brutal Strike · Danger Sense · Epic Boon · Extra Attack · Fast Movement · Feral Instinct · Improved Brutal Strike · Indomitable Might · Instinctive Pounce · Intimidating Presence (Path of the Berserker) · Mindless Rage (Path of the Berserker) · Persistent Rage · Primal Champion · Primal Knowledge · Rage · Reckless Attack · Relentless Rage · Retaliation (Path of the Berserker) · Unarmored Defense · Weapon Mastery

**Reference (1):** Frenzy (Path of the Berserker)

Notes on the curated rows:

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brutal Strike | enforced | After Reckless Attack, the tap forgoes the Advantage of the Barbarian's next Strength attack this turn (resolution/attack.ts), and its hit carries 1d10 of the weapon's type and one effect (resolution/hit-options.ts): Forceful Blow's 15-foot push and a move of half its Speed that must end nearer the target and provokes no Opportunity Attacks (granted-moves.ts), or Hamstring Blow's 15 feet less Speed, one at a time on a creature. |
| Improved Brutal Strike | enforced | Staggering Blow (Disadvantage on the next save and no Opportunity Attacks) and Sundering Blow (+5 to the next attack roll another creature makes against the target) join Brutal Strike's effects, and from Barbarian 17 a hit carries 2d10 and two effects (resolution/hit-options.ts, resolution/attack.ts). |
| Instinctive Pounce | enforced | The Bonus Action that starts a Rage gives the Barbarian a move of half its Speed for the turn (resolution/movement-grants.ts), charged to its own grant (movement-rules.ts). |
| Intimidating Presence (Path of the Berserker) | enforced | The Bonus Action's Wisdom save against Frightened is applied, and conversions.ts restores its use for one use of Rage (actor.convert). |
| Mindless Rage (Path of the Berserker) | enforced | Immunity to Charmed and Frightened while raging is applied (equipment-derivation.ts), and either condition ends as the Rage starts (resolution/grant.ts). |
| Persistent Rage | enforced | When the Barbarian rolls Initiative, initiative-hooks.ts opens its window and the Persistent Rage action restores every expended use of Rage, once per Long Rest (resolution/rage.ts). A Rage under it lasts 10 minutes, and only Unconscious ends it early (effects.ts). |
| Primal Knowledge | enforced | The extra skill is applied. While raging, Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth and Survival checks are made as Strength checks when that is the better roll (ability-checks.ts). |
| Relentless Rage | enforced | hit-points.ts rolls the Constitution save when a raging Barbarian drops to 0 Hit Points and isn't killed outright: DC 10, 5 more for each use since its last rest (rests.ts clears the count). A success leaves it at twice its Barbarian level. |
| Weapon Mastery | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts applies the mastery property of each picked weapon kind. A Barbarian picks melee weapons and a Rogue the weapons it is proficient with. In the step a Long Rest opens, actor.rechoose swaps picks and rebuilds the sheet (ledger-rechoice.ts): one for a Barbarian or Fighter, any for a Paladin, Ranger or Rogue. |

## Bard features

**Enforced (15):** Ability Score Improvement · Bard Subclass · Bonus Proficiencies (College of Lore) · Countercharm · Cutting Words (College of Lore) · Epic Boon · Expertise · Font of Inspiration · Jack of All Trades · Magical Discoveries (College of Lore) · Magical Secrets · Peerless Skill (College of Lore) · Spellcasting · Superior Inspiration · Words of Creation

**Guided (1):** Bardic Inspiration

Notes on the curated rows:

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bardic Inspiration | guided | The Bonus Action gives another creature the Bard's die, a d6 growing to a d12, one die at a time, and roll-answers.ts offers it when that creature fails an attack roll, a save, a check or a death save: the die is added and spent. A creature beyond 60 feet is refused, and an unused die ends after an hour. Whether the creature can see or hear the Bard is the GM's. |
| Countercharm | enforced | roll-answers.ts asks the Bard by a reaction prompt when it or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against an effect that would make it Charmed or Frightened. The save waits, and using the Reaction rerolls it with Advantage. |
| Cutting Words (College of Lore) | enforced | roll-answers.ts asks the Bard by a reaction prompt when a creature it can see within 60 feet hits with an attack roll, succeeds on a check or rolls damage. Using it spends a Bardic Inspiration use and the Reaction and takes the die off the roll, which can turn the hit into a miss or lower the damage before it lands (damage-window.ts). |
| Font of Inspiration | enforced | Bardic Inspiration comes back on a Short Rest, and conversions.ts spends a spell slot for one use of it. |
| Jack of All Trades | enforced | ability-checks.ts adds half the Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, to a skill check the Bard isn't proficient in. |
| Peerless Skill (College of Lore) | enforced | roll-answers.ts offers it on the Bard's failed attack roll or check: the Bardic Inspiration die is added, and the use is kept when the roll still fails. |
| Spellcasting | enforced | character-build.ts gives the class its slots, cantrips and prepared spells, and each spell is a cast action at the class's spell save DC and attack bonus. resolution/economy.ts spends the slot, and rests.ts restores slots on a Long Rest. level-up-picks.ts lets a player's level up replace only the cantrips and spells the class's level allows. |
| Superior Inspiration | enforced | When the Bard rolls Initiative with fewer than two uses of Bardic Inspiration left, initiative-hooks.ts brings it up to two. |
| Words of Creation | enforced | Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill are always prepared, and either may take a second creature within 10 feet of the first (resolution/action-targets.ts). |

| Boon of Fate | enforced | The ability score increase is applied. roll-answers.ts offers Improve Fate on the holder's own D20 Test, and asks by a prompt about another creature's within 60 feet: 2d4 is added or taken off, and the use returns when Initiative is rolled or on a rest. |

| Boon of the Night Spirit | enforced | The ability score increase is applied. With dynamic vision on, Merge with Shadows makes the creature Invisible as a Bonus Action only in Dim Light or Darkness (resolution/validate.ts), until it next takes an action, a Bonus Action or a Reaction (resolution/release.ts), and hit-points.ts gives it Resistance to all damage but Psychic and Radiant there. |
| Boon of Truesight | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, and Truesight 60 feet is a sense dynamic vision and attack rolls read (vision/senses.ts). |
| Grappler | guided | The ability score increase is applied, and attack rolls against a creature it grapples have Advantage (resolution/attack.ts). Punch and Grab and Fast Wrestler are the GM's. |
| Savage Attacker | enforced | resolution/hit-options.ts offers it on a weapon hit once a turn. Chosen, resolution/damage.ts rolls the weapon's damage dice twice and uses the higher roll, the one an attacker always picks of the two. |
| Two-Weapon Fighting | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts adds the ability modifier to the damage of the Light property's extra attack. |

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amulet of the Planes | guided | Its Plane Shift is cast only after a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check, which the server rolls in a fight and outside one; a failure spends the action and casts nothing (cast-check.ts). Where a failure sends its wearer and those within 15 feet, on the d100 table, is the GM's. |
| Armor of Invulnerability | enforced | Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage is applied, and Metal Shell's Magic action gives Immunity to them for 10 minutes once a dawn, ending if the armor comes off (inventory.ts). |
| Bag of Beans | guided | inventory.ts rolls its 3d4 beans when it is added, which never come back, and the bag is a plain one once they are gone. Dumped beans explode in a 10-foot Sphere, DC 15 Dexterity for 5d4 Force, half on a success. What a planted bean grows, on its d100 table, is the GM's. |
| Bag of Tricks | enforced | The GM says which bag a found one is (item-records.ts); its pull rolls the d8 on that bag's table, and the creature appears within 20 feet acting right after its user until the next Long Rest or 0 Hit Points (summons.ts). A Bonus Action commands it (summon-orders.ts). |
| Bead of Force | enforced | Throwing a bead uses it up: each creature in the 10-foot-radius Sphere makes the DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 5d4 Force damage, and one that fails is shut in the sphere for a minute, which no attack or effect passes (enclosures.ts). Pushing out the creatures that saved, and rolling the sphere, are the GM's. |
| Berserker Axe | guided | The +1 to attack and damage rolls and the curse's lock on Attunement are applied. berserker-axe.ts asks the DC 15 Wisdom save when another creature damages the bearer, and ends the berserk on a turn that starts with no creature within 60 feet. Its attacks on the nearest creature, and the extra Hit Points, are the GM's. |
| Boots of Levitation | enforced | The action levitates the wearer with no save for up to 10 minutes on its Concentration (effects.ts), which damage, another Concentration spell or Incapacitation ends: it rises 20 feet, moves only as if climbing, and floats down when the levitation ends (falling.ts). |
| Boots of Speed | enforced | A Bonus Action doubles its wearer's Speed (speed.ts) and gives Opportunity Attacks against it Disadvantage. Its 10 minutes a Long Rest are 100 rounds: a click lasts all that is left, and ending it early gives the rest back (use-cost.ts, effects.ts). |
| Boots of Striding and Springing | guided | Its wearer's Speed is at least 30 feet and armor's Strength requirement takes none of it (speed.ts), and the once-a-turn leap of 30 feet for 10 feet of movement is applied (jumping.ts). Carried weight is the GM's. |
| Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, a Water Elemental appears near its user, acts right after it, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). Filling the bowl is the GM's. |
| Bracers of Archery | enforced | Proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and +2 to damage rolls made with either (a magic one bound to it included), are applied (riders.ts). |
| Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, a Fire Elemental appears near its user, acts right after it, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). |
| Brooch of Shielding | guided | Resistance to Force damage is applied. Immunity to Magic Missile is the GM's. |
| Broom of Flying | enforced | The action gives the rider a Fly Speed of 50 feet with hover, which ends when it lands (falling.ts) or when it gets off on the sheet. Its slower 30 feet while it carries over 200 pounds needs the rider's body weight, which no sheet records, and sending it alone to a place within a mile is story. |
| Candle of Invocation | guided | Lit, it sheds Dim Light 30 feet for its 4 hours (item-light.ts), and while it burns its attuned bearer has Advantage on attack rolls, saves, checks and Initiative. It casts Gate once, which destroys it. Whether an alignment matches the candle's, the others in its light, slot-free level 1 spells for a Cleric or Druid, Gate only at the first lighting, and the minutes a snuffed candle keeps are the GM's. |
| Cape of the Mountebank | guided | The cast of Dimension Door, once a dawn, teleports the wearer on the map (granted-moves.ts). The smoke cloud is the GM's. |
| Carpet of Flying | enforced | The GM says which of the four sizes a carpet is, and a Magic action makes it hover and fly with its user at that size's Fly Speed until it lands (falling.ts). Its weight limits and half speed, and steering it from 30 feet away, need what the sheet doesn't record. |
| Censer of Controlling Air Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, an Air Elemental appears near its user, acts right after it, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). |
| Chime of Opening | enforced | Each strike casts Knock on its 10 charges, which never come back, and the last one cracks it (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Cloak of Arachnida | enforced | Resistance to Poison damage and a Climb Speed equal to its wearer's Speed are applied. The webs of a Web spell can't hold the wearer (spell-zones.ts), and its Web cast is DC 13 over a 40-foot Cube once a Long Rest. Climbing upside down on ceilings is the GM's to allow. |
| Cloak of the Bat | guided | Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks is applied. The Fly Speed in darkness and the Polymorph cast are the GM's. |
| Crystal Ball of Mind Reading | guided | It casts Scrying at DC 17, and Detect Thoughts at DC 17 only through that Scrying: it takes no Concentration of its own and ends with the Scrying (resolution/concentration.ts). Which creatures stand within 30 feet of the sensor is the GM's. |
| Crystal Ball of Telepathy | guided | It casts Scrying at DC 17, and Suggestion at DC 17 once a dawn only through that Scrying: it takes no Concentration of its own and ends with the Scrying (resolution/concentration.ts). Speaking telepathically with creatures near the sensor, and which of them it can reach, are the GM's. |
| Cube of Force | guided | Mage Armor, Shield (a Reaction when its holder is hit), Tiny Hut, Private Sanctum, Resilient Sphere and Wall of Force are casts at DC 17 on its 10 charges at their printed costs, 1d6 back at dawn (item-actions.ts). It takes the state of Tiny Hut and Private Sanctum. |
| Dagger of Venom | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls is applied. Coating the blade is a Bonus Action once a day, and the dagger's next hit spends it on a DC 15 Constitution save against 2d10 Poison and Poisoned for 1 minute (resolution/on-hit.ts). |
| Defender | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls is applied, and its wielder moves 1, 2 or 3 of it to AC as a form on the sheet before its first attack of a turn, held until its next turn starts and giving AC only while it holds the weapon (inventory.ts setItemForm, turn-boundaries.ts). |
| Demon Armor | guided | The +1 AC and the curse's lock on Attunement are applied. The clawed Unarmed Strikes and the Disadvantage against demons are the GM's. |
| Dragon Orb | guided | Its spells cost their printed charges from 7 (1d4 + 3 back at dawn): Cure Wounds at level 9 for 4, Daylight for 1, Death Ward for 2, Detect Magic for none, Scrying at DC 18 for 3; Call Dragons waits an hour of game time (clock-pools.ts). Peering into it, its Charm and Suggestion on a user who fails the DC 15 Charisma save, the spells answering only to one who controls it, and its AC 20 are the GM's. |
| Dragon Scale Mail | enforced | The +1 AC and the Resistance to the type the GM picks are applied, with Advantage on saves against a Dragon's breath weapon (saving-throws.ts). Its Magic action to sense the nearest dragon is counted once a dawn; the distance and direction it tells are the GM's. |
| Dust of Sneezing and Choking | guided | Thrown, it opens the DC 15 Constitution save against Incapacitated on its thrower and every creature in its 30-foot Emanation but Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants and Undead, repeated at the end of each turn, and is used up. Suffocating is the GM's. |
| Dwarven Plate | guided | The +2 AC is applied. The Reaction against forced movement is the GM's. |
| Dwarven Thrower | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls is applied, it is thrown 20/60 (inventory.ts weapon changes), and a ranged hit deals 1d8 Force more, 2d8 against a Giant. Only a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind attunes to it (attunement.ts); it flies back to its thrower's hand. |
| Efreeti Bottle | guided | Opened the first time, an Efreeti appears within 30 feet and the server rolls the d10, which settles the bottle (summons.ts): on a 1 it attacks its user and leaves after 5 rounds, on a 10 it stays up to an hour to grant a Wish, and either way the bottle's magic is gone; on 2 to 9 it obeys for 1 hour and the bottle holds a servant from then on, which comes twice more, each opening 24 hours after it returns (clock-pools.ts), and then the bottle is spent. What the Wish does is the GM's. |
| Elemental Gem | enforced | The GM says which gem a found one is (item-records.ts): breaking it uses it up, and its elemental appears beside its user, acts right after it and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts). |
| Energy Bow | guided | It binds to its Longbow or Shortbow with +1 to attack and damage rolls, and its arrows deal Force damage with no ammunition to spend (inventory.ts weapon changes). The arrows' light, Arrow of Restraint, Arrow of Transport and the Energy Ladder are the GM's. |
| Feather Token | guided | The GM says which token a found one is (item-records.ts). The Bird token is used up for a Roc that can't attack and obeys its user until it is dismissed with a Magic action or drops to 0 Hit Points (summons.ts). The Anchor, Fan, Swan Boat, Tree and Whip are the GM's. |
| Figurine of Wondrous Power | guided | The GM says which figurine a found one is (item-records.ts): its creature appears within 60 feet for its time, acts right after its user and defends itself when uncommanded, and a Magic action turns it back (summons.ts). Its days of waiting start when it reverts (clock-pools.ts), each Golden Lion and each Ivory Goat on its own; the Goat of Traveling spends an hour or part of one each time from its 24 and waits only once they are spent. The Goat of Terror can't attack, the Onyx Dog has Blindsight 60 feet, the Silver Raven offers Animal Messenger, and the Obsidian Steed's d10 shows 1 one time in ten, leaving it under no one's command. The Goat of Terror's horns and fear, the steed refusing to revert and its ride to Hades are the GM's. |
| Gem of Brightness | enforced | Its light is lit and put out on the row, and its beam (1 charge) and flare (5 charges) open the DC 15 Constitution save against Blinded on its 50 charges, which never come back; with none left it is a plain jewel that no longer lights (item-spent.ts). |
| Giant Slayer | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls and the extra 2d6 against Giants are applied, and a hit on a Giant opens its DC 15 Strength save against Prone (resolution/on-hit.ts). |
| Gloves of Missile Snaring | enforced | A hit by a weapon from range opens a reaction prompt (damage-window.ts), and using it takes 1d10 plus the wearer's Dexterity modifier off the damage. Whether a hand is free, and catching the missile, are the GM's. |
| Hammer of Thunderbolts | guided | The +1 to attack and damage rolls is applied. Its thrown thunderclap and its powers against Giants are the GM's. |
| Helm of Brilliance | guided | inventory.ts counts each kind of gem when the helm is added (1d10 diamonds, 2d10 rubies, 3d10 fire opals, 4d10 opals), which never come back, and each of its spells at DC 18 spends one gem of its kind: Daylight an opal, Fireball a fire opal, Prismatic Spray a diamond, Wall of Fire a ruby. Diamond Light against Undead, Fire Opal Flames, Ruby Resistance while a ruby is left, the helm losing its magic once every gem is gone, and the d20 when Fire from a spell lands are the GM's. |
| Helm of Telepathy | guided | Its Detect Thoughts and Suggestion casts are cast actions. The telepathy itself is the GM's. |
| Holy Avenger | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls and the extra 2d10 Radiant against Fiends and Undead are applied, and its 10-foot Emanation (30 feet for a level 17 Paladin) gives its wielder and its allies Advantage on saves against magic (saving-throws.ts magicSaveAuraClaims). Only a Paladin attunes to it (attunement.ts). |
| Horn of Blasting | enforced | Its blast fills a 30-foot Cone with a DC 15 Constitution save: 5d8 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute on a failure, half on a success. Each use rolls the d100 for its 20 percent chance to explode, dealing 10d6 Force to its user and destroying it (resolution/charges.ts, item-breaks.ts). The glass and crystal objects it shatters are story. |
| Horn of Valhalla | enforced | Each metal is its own action: 2 to 5 Berserkers appear within 60 feet for 1 hour, immune to Charmed and Frightened (summons.ts). They obey a user whose sheet has the metal's training and attack one whose sheet lacks it. clock-pools.ts keeps it from being blown again until 7 days have passed on the game clock. |
| Horseshoes of a Zephyr | guided | The creature wearing all four ignores Difficult Terrain (movement-rules.ts). Floating over water or lava is the GM's until the map holds water and lava areas; its tracks and its 12 hours of travel a day are overland travel the app doesn't run. |
| Ioun Stone | guided | The GM says which stone a found one is (item-records.ts), the bearer learns it on attuning, and two stones of different kinds attune as two items. Agility, Fortitude, Insight, Intellect, Leadership and Strength raise their score live (live-abilities.ts); Awareness and Protection are applied. Absorption, Greater Absorption, Mastery, Regeneration, Reserve and Sustenance are the GM's. |
| Iron Bands | guided | The throw's attack roll is applied. Restraining the target on a hit, and the check to break free, are the GM's. |
| Iron Flask | guided | The command's save is applied. Trapping the creature in the flask is the GM's. |
| Javelin of Lightning | enforced | It may deal Lightning damage on a hit, and once a dawn it becomes a bolt: a 5-foot Line from its thrower that ends at a target within 120 feet (annotations.ts), DC 13 Dexterity save for 4d6 Lightning, half on a success. |
| Luck Blade | guided | The +1 to attack and damage rolls and saving throws is applied, and roll-answers.ts offers its Luck reroll on a failed D20 Test once a day while the wielder isn't Incapacitated. Its Wish casts on 1d3 charges rolled when it is added, which never come back, and once a dawn (resolution/economy.ts). What a Wish does is the GM's. |
| Mace of Disruption | enforced | The extra 2d6 Radiant against Fiends and Undead and the weapon's light are applied. | Mace of Smiting | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls, +3 against Constructs, and the 7 Bludgeoning on a rolled 20 (14 against a Construct) are applied. A Construct that rolled 20 leaves at 25 Hit Points or fewer is destroyed (resolution/kill.ts). |
| Mace of Terror | guided | Its 3 charges come back 1d3 at dawn, and each opens the DC 15 Wisdom save against Frightened for a minute on the creatures its wielder picks within 30 feet, repeated at the end of each turn. That a Frightened creature flees and only Dashes is the GM's. |
| Manual of Bodily Health | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Constitution rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Manual of Gainful Exercise | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Strength rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Manual of Quickness of Action | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Dexterity rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Necklace of Fireballs | enforced | inventory.ts rolls its 1d6 + 3 beads when it is added, and each bead casts a level 3 Fireball at DC 15 and never comes back; up to five hurled at once add 1d6 each, to 12d6 (item-actions.ts). |
| Nine Lives Stealer | enforced | The +2 to attack and damage rolls is applied. On a rolled 20 against a creature with fewer than 100 Hit Points, other than a Construct or an Undead, the target makes the DC 15 Constitution save, and a failure slays it (resolution/kill.ts). Each slaying spends one of the 1d8 + 1 charges rolled when the sword is added, which never come back, and with none left it slays no more. |
| Oathbow | guided | Naming a sworn enemy marks it for 7 days, once a day, and the bow's ranged attacks against it have Advantage, set Half and Three-Quarters Cover aside and deal 3d6 Piercing more. Ignoring long range's Disadvantage, and the Disadvantage with other weapons while it lives, are the GM's. |
| Oil of Slipperiness | guided | Applied, it is used up and its creature has Freedom of Movement's effect for 8 hours: a Swim Speed equal to its Speed, and no Paralyzed or Restrained. Poured as Grease on a 10-foot square for 8 hours is the GM's. |
| Pearl of Power | enforced | Its Magic action restores one expended slot of level 3 or lower, once per Long Rest (conversions.ts). |
| Periapt of Wound Closure | enforced | death-saves.ts counts an attuned wearer's death save of 9 or lower as a 10, and rests.ts and resolution/hit-point-die.ts double what each Hit Point Die it rolls to heal restores. |
| Pipes of Haunting | enforced | Its 3 charges come back 1d3 at dawn; each opens the DC 15 Wisdom save against Frightened for a minute on the creatures its user picks within 30 feet, repeated at the end of each turn, and a creature that succeeds is immune to the pipes for the rest of the fight (resolution/pending.ts). |
| Potion of Diminution | enforced | Drinking it makes the drinker one size smaller for 1d4 hours, rolled by the server, with Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves and 1d4 less damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes, never below 1 (resolution/damage.ts). |
| Potion of Gaseous Form | enforced | Drinking it gives Gaseous Form's misty cloud for 1 hour with no Concentration, ended early as a Bonus Action or at 0 Hit Points. |
| Potion of Growth | enforced | Drinking it makes the drinker one size larger for 10 minutes, with Advantage on Strength checks and saves and 1d4 more damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes. The token takes the new size (transform/forms.ts). |
| Potion of Mind Reading | guided | Drunk, it is used up and its drinker bears Detect Thoughts for 10 minutes with no Concentration. The thoughts it reads, and the DC 13 save a creature makes against a deeper probe, are the GM's. |
| Potion of Poison | guided | Drinking it deals its 4d6 Poison damage to the drinker. The DC 13 Constitution save against an hour of Poisoned, and its disguise, are the GM's: the GM names the row. |
| Potion of Vitality | guided | Drinking it ends the drinker's Exhaustion and the Poisoned condition. The next 24 hours of Hit Point Dice at their most are the GM's. |
| Potion of Water Breathing | enforced | Drinking it lets the drinker breathe underwater for 24 hours of game time (breath.ts). |
| Quarterstaff of the Acrobat | enforced | The +2 to attack and damage rolls and Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks are applied, it is thrown 30/120, and Attack Deflection is offered once a rest when a hit would land (resolution/pending.ts). | Ring of Elemental Command | guided | Elemental Bane's Advantage on attacks against Elementals and their Disadvantage against its wearer, and Elemental Compulsion's DC 18 save against Charmed, are applied. The languages, breathing water and moving through earth are the GM's. |
| Ring of Free Action | guided | Difficult Terrain costs its wearer no extra movement (movement-rules.ts). That magic can't reduce its Speeds or give it the Paralyzed or Restrained condition is the GM's to apply, since the engine doesn't yet tell a magical source from another. |
| Ring of Shooting Stars | guided | Its at-will cantrips and the one-charge Shooting Stars are applied. Faerie Fire, the Lightning Spheres and the larger Shooting Stars are the GM's. |
| Ring of Spell Turning | guided | Its wearer has Advantage on saves against spells, and a successful save against a spell of level 7 or lower leaves the spell no effect on it: no half damage, nothing a success would leave (saving-throws.ts). | Ring of Three Wishes | guided | Its three Wish casts are counted and never come back, and the ring is nonmagical after the last (resolution/charges.ts, item-spent.ts). What a Wish does is the GM's. |

| Robe of Stars | guided | The +1 to saving throws is applied, and its six stars each cast a level 5 Magic Missile, 1d6 coming back at dusk or a Long Rest. The trip to the Astral Plane is the GM's. |
| Rod of Alertness | guided | Advantage on Initiative and Wisdom (Perception) checks, and its detection casts, are applied. The Protective Aura's benefit to allies is the GM's. |
| Rod of Lordly Might | enforced | It swings as a +3 Mace; Drain Life (healing its wielder half the Necrotic damage a failed save deals) and Paralyze ride a melee hit and Terrify is an action, each once a day. | Rod of Resurrection | enforced | Its casts spend their printed charges, and it regains 1 charge at dawn or at a Long Rest (item-charges.ts). |

| Scimitar of Speed | enforced | The +2 to attack and damage rolls is applied, and it offers an attack as a Bonus Action beside its own (equipment-derivation.ts). |
